extra.reason: Fixed: run_sync now blocks on a newer project layout, mirroring run_refresh
Fixed: reads result['action'], handles blocked, and now has test coverage

Fixed both multiplied causes: kc_normalize_relative_path now returns via caller-named variable (printf -v, bash 3.2 safe) with ignore patterns normalized once at load — zero forks in the filter hot path (1000-line benchmark: 77.9s -> ~0.1s); and run_bash_script now escapes Rosetta with arch -arm64 when Python runs translated. Fresh-repo init: 16.9s -> 3.2s. Covered by tests in tests/test_cli.py and tests/test_shell.py; full suite 253 passed.

kc_yaml_leaf_value strips a trailing \r before the key/quote strips, so CRLF checkouts parse clean values and quoted values lose their trailing quote again. Byte-level regression test added (test_yaml_leaf_value_strips_cr_on_crlf_files). No .gitattributes needed: both kc_status_load and kc_yaml_leaf_value now tolerate CRLF.
